repository.description: Canonical path of the routed repository.

authority.description: orbit_sync: the workspace and public interfaces the adapter used.

coverage.description: What this call covered and how to resume a partial result. graph_sync: complete, state (published or budget_exhausted), phase reached when the budget ran out, and a resume hint.

result.description: Operation report: the history sync or import outcome, or for graph_sync the requested mode, budget, file counts, per-phase timings, and the failed and skipped paths (each a count and its entries, as in the CLI sync output; null when the budget ran out before the build reported them).

outcomes.description: orbit_sync: per-run outcome (inserted, already_indexed, or excluded with a reason).

status.description: orbit_sync: change-history status after the call.

code_index.description: The plugin-owned code-graph index that combined and graph-only recommendations read structure from. Maintained by graph_sync.

state.description: missing: nothing published yet (run graph_sync); incompatible: built by another extractor or schema (run graph_sync with full: true); ready: a complete index is published.

directory.description: Plugin state directory that holds this repository's code-graph index.

published.description: Metadata of the published generation (present unless state is missing).

database.description: Generation database file name inside the plugin state directory.

extractor_version.description: Extractor version that built the index.

store_schema_version.description: Graph store schema version that built the index.

revision.description: Checkout commit when the build started; null on an unborn branch.

worktree_dirty.description: Whether tracked or untracked (non-ignored) files differed from revision when the build started; the index reflects the working tree.

mode.description: full when every file was extracted, incremental when the build started from the previous published index.

checkout_revision.description: Current checkout commit, or null when HEAD is unborn or unreadable.

fresh.description: True when a ready index was built at checkout_revision, so recommendations for the checkout apply structure; false means graph_sync should run.
